title: Everybody’s playing the game, but nobody’s rules are the same #Chess ...
transcript: Have you ever watched a musical and thought, man, I wish I could play those characters in chess? Then, boy, do I have great news for you, because chess com and chess the musical have teamed up to create bot versions of the characters from chess the musical, which means that you can now play chess against Robot Aaron Tveit, Robot Leah Michelle, or Robot Nick Christopher. And unironically, I kind of love this. Like, yes, it's silly, goofy, but it's also the kind of out of the box brand partnerships that, quite frankly, more shows should be doing. And as someone who has never played chess online, it does kind of make me wanna go on chess com to play a match against robot Leah Michelle. Now, I do naturally have some questions, does robot Leah Michelle play chess differently than robot Aaron Tveit? Which bot is better at chess, Aaron Tveit or Nick Christopher? Because we never find out in the musical. If I choose to play chess against robot Nick Christopher, is the KGB gonna try and intervene and influence the results of the match? Or is an FBI agent gonna reach out to me personally and tell me I have to throw the match? Otherwise the world's gonna explode? These are the questions that I have.
